execution_message.text: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: KCK-03B2 side model-sheet correction, ONE PNG candidate only. Image 1 is the failed SIDE edit target; Image 2 is the Owner-approved identity/rendering reference ONLY, not the output camera pose. Preserve exact Soft Handmade 2.5D paper grain, warm brown outline, palette, large-head/short-body proportions and genuine alpha. Entire full body on square canvas with clear transparent margin; no text, collage, duplicate character, floor, cast shadow, new props, white matte or watermark. Screen light stays upper left. Keep visible eye anatomy and upper-left primary/lower-right small glints. Do NOT return Image 2 front camera; keep side nose pointing SCREEN LEFT. Change ONLY the tail in Image 1. The Cat must keep the reference's seated tail pose: it emerges at rump, lies FLAT ALONG THE GROUND, wraps around the seated body to rest in FRONT of the feet toward the nose (screen LEFT in this side view). Tail tip must lie low, at foot level, in front of the toes. REMOVE the upright curl behind the back entirely. There must be NO tail section rising behind the torso and NO high curled tail tip on screen right. Preserve tail thickness, length and orange/cream stripes; show plausible side projection of the grounded curl. Keep Image 1 head/face/ears, one near eye with brown iris and white sclera, whiskers, tongue, raised anatomical left paw with pads, resting forepaw, seated haunch and feet unchanged. Do not rotate the head/torso further, change pose or redesign Cat.
